short: Pooled EEG/EMG pretraining lifts 64-word accuracy, but each test subject's training sessions, the patient's included, are in pretraining; the coordinate kernel is neither new nor best.
position: The paper changes the input layer for heterogeneous electrode layouts (M06) and pooled multi-subject, multi-task pretraining with calibration (M03); both are standard. Coordinate-conditioned input layers predate it, and its proposed kernel is beaten by a fixed per-subject layer. The gains (70.1% to 95.3% healthy, 13.2% to 54.5% for one patient) hold within the paper, but the pretraining set contains every subject's word-task training sessions, the patient's 16 included, and data volume grows with devices, tasks and supervision at once. No EEG-only or EMG-only model is reported. New-user generalization is an untabulated calibration curve, and other patients are untested.
